idea-plugin.name: Parakeet for Inko
idea-plugin.description:
Parakeet is unofficial, community-made support for the Inko programming language.

  • Syntax highlighting for .inko files
  • Line comment toggling (#)
  • Bracket matching, auto-closing pairs, and surrounding pairs
  • Compiler errors and warnings as you type, from inko check
  • Reformat Code (and format on save) with inko fmt

Requires the inko executable, found on PATH, in ivm's install directory, or configured in Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Inko.

Uses the TextMate grammar and language configuration from inko-lang/vscode (MPL-2.0). This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Inko project.
